definitions.aggregate_values: M11b v2.0 references and scorer do not record or check per-region aggregate values.
definitions.executable: Reached tool execution in every run of the configuration.
definitions.frontend_round: Per run, one logical model call per task in seeded order; decisions shared by every model-using configuration; validator_no_frontend makes no model call.
definitions.latency_ms: System time plus the task's front-end wall time.
definitions.llm_calls: HTTP attempts of the task's logical call (at most 2); identical across model configs.
definitions.model_failure: Logical call without a schema-valid frame after 2 attempts; denominator = logical calls.
definitions.secondary_pass: Diagnostic, non-official: every component passed except required_steps.
definitions.strict_pass: Official M11b v2.0 TaskScore.passed (scorer unchanged); primary metric.
